No-Code App Builder

Bubble is a software development platform that enables anyone to build and launch web and mobile applications without writing code. Rather than specializing in one or two aspects of development (like designing landing pages or building databases), Bubble’s full-stack visual programming interface does it all. That means anyone from first-time founders to enterprises can take an idea from concept to fully functional, scalable reality — faster and cheaper than you could with just code. [...] Based on 71 reviews

Review Bubble?

Reviewers largely see Bubble as a powerful way to build real web apps fast, especially for non-technical founders and MVPs, with strong support for workflows, databases, auth, plugins, and prototyping. Many say it can handle fairly complex products once you learn it. The main drawbacks are consistent: a steeper learning curve than advertised, sluggish performance compared with coded apps, clunky advanced API work, and weak mobile responsiveness that needs manual fixes. A few also mention scaling limits, an outdated interface, rotating IP issues, and frustrating subscription cancellation.

The visual editor is powerful, the plugin ecosystem covers most integrations, and it's far cheaper than hiring a dev team for an MVP.
